column1: # CORE inference-only ablations on the RELEASED qm9_default checkpoint (budgeted plan, notes/ablation_plan_qm9.md
# section 3). One line per SLURM array index (comments/blank lines ignored). Fields separated by '|':
#   NAME | MODEL | STEPS | SEED | NO_ENERGY(1/0) | extra generate_confs.py args
# MODEL: PRE (= released qm9_default), PRE1 (= released qm9_1order), BASE (= $MODEL_BASE, default $WORK/qm9_baseline_s0),
#        or an absolute path. Paths in args are relative to the repo root; $VARS are expanded.
# R0 on PRE is the reproduction check against TD Table 7 (the former P0 line). Seed-s lines share ETKDG seed s+1 with
# R<s>, so every arm is paired per molecule with R<s> on the same RDKit local structures.
# Deferred lines (steps, ODE, sigma, 1st-order irreps, H pools): ablations_inference_deferred.tsv.
